ui.title: Floppy Station
ui.events.intro: What Floppy Station is doing. Insert or remove a disk to see it here.
drive_disconnected: Drive {drive} not found. Plug the drive in, or pick another letter in Preferences.
disk_not_configured: This disk has no game yet.
disk_config_invalid: The game file on this disk is damaged: {detail}
disk_unsupported_version: This disk was set up by a newer version of Floppy Station.
disk_unsupported_kind: This disk uses a game type this version doesn't know ({kind}).
disk_unformatted: This disk isn't formatted. Format it in File Explorer first.
disk_unreadable: This disk can't be read. It may be damaged.
config_syntax: The file has a syntax error: {detail}
disk_write_protected: The disk is write protected. Slide the tab and try again.
disk_in_use: Another program is using the disk. Close File Explorer windows on it and try again.
disk_removed: The disk was removed while writing. Insert it and try again.
disk_write_failed: The file could not be verified after writing. Try again or use another disk.
disk_io: The disk could not be written: {detail}
game_ignored_at_startup: {name}: the disk was already in the drive when Floppy Station started. Remove and insert it to play.
launch_untrusted: {name}: this disk wants to run a program you haven't approved.
game_reattached: {name} is still open from before the drive was unplugged.
launch_not_found: Couldn't start {name}: the program isn't installed on this PC (the disk may come from another PC).
launch_elevation_required: Couldn't start {name}: the program needs administrator rights. Floppy Station doesn't start those, because it couldn't close them.
launch_failed: Couldn't start {name}: Windows couldn't start it (error {error}).
left_open_setting: {name} was left open: your preferences say to leave games open.
left_open_drive_disconnected: {name} was left open: the drive was unplugged, and your preferences say to leave the game open.
left_open_no_process: {name} was left open: no process to close is set for this game.
close_failed: {name} could not be closed (it may be running as administrator).
settings_appdata_unavailable: Floppy Station can't find its settings folder.
settings_invalid: The settings file is damaged; default settings are in use.
settings_io: Floppy Station can't read or save its settings: {detail}
settings_serialize: Floppy Station couldn't save its settings.
trust_appdata_unavailable: Floppy Station can't find its settings folder.
trust_invalid: The approved programs file is damaged; no program is approved until it is fixed.
trust_io: Floppy Station can't read or save the approved programs: {detail}
trust_serialize: Floppy Station couldn't save the approved programs.
